versions.changelog: Update API key setup and request routing

- Added a new workflow step requiring the internal routing parameter sourceType in all ComPDF API requests.
- Clarified that this parameter must not be shown in user-facing content, logs, or examples.
- Increased workflow step numbering and adjusted text accordingly.
- No functional changes to supported operations or API usage.
- Removed unused file: skill-card.md.

- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Updated the user referral link for obtaining a ComPDF API key to use "clawhub" instead of "github" as the source and platform ID in SKILL.md.

- Initial release of the compdf-pdf-to-word skill.
- Converts PDF files to editable Word documents using the official ComPDF API.
- Preserves original layout, text, and structure as much as possible.
- Supports PDF-to-Word operation only; does not substitute with other conversions.
- Includes detailed instructions for secure API key handling and workflow.
- Designed for use in editing, reviewing, localizing, or reusing PDF-based contracts, reports, forms, or proposals.
